title: DLMF 4.10 Integrals: The left-hand side of ( 4.10.7 ) is a Cauchy principal value (§ 1.4(v) ).
summary: DLMF 4.10 Integrals: The left-hand side of ( 4.10.7 ) is a Cauchy principal value (§ 1.4(v) ).
body: NIST DLMF section 4.10 (Integrals) says: "The left-hand side of ( 4.10.7 ) is a Cauchy principal value (§ 1.4(v) ). For \operatorname{li}\left(x\right) see § 6.2(i) . Extensive compendia of indefinite and definite integrals of logarithms and exponentials include Apelblat ( 1983 , pp. 16–47) , Bierens de Haan ( 1939 ) , Gröbner and Hofreiter ( 1949 , pp. 107–116) , Gröbner and Hofreiter ( 1950 , pp. 52–90) , Gradshteyn and Ryzhik ( 2015 , Chapters 2–4) , and Prudnikov et al. ( 1986a , §§1.3, 1.6, 2.3, 2.6) ." Equation 4.10.1 on the page has alt text "\int\frac{\,\mathrm{d}z}{z}=\ln z,". Equation 4.10.2 on the page has alt text "\int\ln z\,\mathrm{d}z=z\ln z-z,". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
